lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Pal,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: can you talk for a moment?
Sure, what's up?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: There are many different disciplines of martial arts in the world,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: and everyone purports that theirs is the best.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I've tried them all,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: and to be honest, I can't tell which comes out on top.
Okay.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Boxing, Kickboxing, Taekwondo, Karate,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Savate, Sambo, MMA, Judo, Sumo, Tai Chi...
You're learning all of those?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Oh no, just a select few.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Anyway, since you've dabbled in martial arts as well,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I wanted to get your thoughts on the matter.
It doesn't matter which discipline you use. Whoever is strongest will come out on top.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: When you put it that way...

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I'm jonesing for a sparring match!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Where are you right now?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Let's have a go!
I'll be waiting.
